items.html: *And this is what is said in the portion Acharei Mot, page 61, and this is its language: 'Come see, it is written, "And a river goes out of Eden to water the garden." This river spreads to its sides at the time that this Eden couples with her in a complete coupling, etc.; then it is written, "While the king was on his couch, etc.", and the upper and the lower are blessed, etc.' — end of his language. Explanation of the matters: that Bina spreads in her six extremities to crown the pleasant son; and this is when the upper coupling is complete in the two kinds of bounty.
